answer.rationale: Roll out signup and onboarding simplification across self-serve SMB. It has confirmed improvements in completion, time-to-value, activation, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not counter the competitor with broad promotional pricing: recovered experiment exp_73 showed that the acquisition and qualified-revenue lift from a 40% targeted discount came with a 12% 30-day retention decline, making it unsuitable as a sustainable response. This will not fully eliminate price-driven churn risk, and the price-cut result should be re-verified when archive access reopens.
